name: Dual-Image Soft-Brush Liquid Cursor Reveal & Adaptive Rem Grid Kinematics
description: Full-bleed before/after dual-image liquid reveal painting a secondary image along the cursor trail using an offscreen radial-gradient brush, destination-out decay with idle ramp, and dynamic source-in cover compositing, paired with an adaptive rem-based viewport grid and 3-digit intro loader.
designPhilosophy: Transforming static hero photography into an interactive tactile canvas. Moving the pointer paints a soft, feathered aperture revealing an alternate aesthetic beneath (e.g. wireframe, color grade, or behind-the-scenes state), which organically dissolves back into the base image with destination-out decay and idle-ramped clearing. Coupled with proportional rem scaling, typography and layout stay mathematically harmonious across ultrawide monitors and mobile viewports.
appropriateUseCases: Creative studio & engineering agency hero sections
Before/after photography showcases (retouching, grading, architectural renders)
Interactive product unveilings and dual-state brand reveals
Auteur portfolios requiring tactile cursor engagement
implementationApproach: 1. Dual-Image Layering: Mount the base image (beforeSrc) as an LCP with object-fit: cover, overlaid with a transparent . 2. Offscreen Buffers: Allocate a 'cover' canvas scaled to container rect × dpr drawing the secondary image (afterSrc) with object-fit: cover math. Allocate a 'brush' canvas square of diameter = ceil(brushRadius * 2 * dpr). 3. Brush Feathering: Render a radial gradient onto the brush canvas with stops at 0 (rgba(255,255,255,1)), 0.55 (rgba(255,255,255,0.82)), and 1 (rgba(255,255,255,0)). 4. Pointer Interpolation: On pointermove, convert client coordinates to canvas space and interpolate intermediate steps (step = max(radius*0.3, 1), up to 60 points) to prevent disjointed stamping during high-velocity mouse swipes. 5. Compositing & Decay: In the rAF tick, apply globalCompositeOperation = 'destination-out' with fillStyle = rgba(0,0,0,fade) where fade increases as idle time climbs. For each point, stamp the brush with source-in clipped cover pixels onto the main canvas. 6. Adaptive Rem Grid: Scale root font-size via CSS vw media queries (1920/1440/1024/360 base widths) and dynamic JS interpolation for viewports > 1920px (FONT_BASE - (FONT_BASE * widthReduction * 0.6666) / 100).
relevantTechnologies: Rem-based adaptive grid with CSS viewport units & JS ultrawide scaling
performanceConsiderations: Caches offscreen canvas buffers, limits dpr to min(devicePixelRatio, 2), throttles idle loop after 120 frames with a clean clearRect, and avoids all DOM layout reflows during pointer movement.
accessibilityRequirements: Strictly honors prefers-reduced-motion: reduce by bypassing the canvas rendering loop entirely and leaving the static base image accessible. Ensures cursor trail canvas has pointer-events: none and aria-hidden='true'.
